Tells whether a graphics driver can draw 3D.
@param driver  Number of the driver, from 1 to the number that [CountGfxDrivers](CountGfxDrivers) reports.
@returns True if the driver can draw 3D pictures.
@gap A GPU can unless it does not do Vulkan 1.3 or has no queue that draws, which is 0. Software drivers can.
